site_area_sqm.formula: projected area of submitted provisional SITE_BOUNDARY in EPSG:4548

land_use_partition_area_sqm.formula: sum projected areas of topology-derived LAND_USE partition

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: sum projected areas of conceptual BUILDING_FOOTPRINT features

green_ratio.formula: projected GREEN_SPACE area / submitted provisional boundary area

public_space_ratio.formula: projected PUBLIC_SPACE area / submitted provisional boundary area

concept_walk_network_length_m.formula: projected length of conceptual staffed ordinary-service and equal-remedy route

named_human_role_count.formula: count distinct named human decision roles in same-error protocol

entry_gate_count.formula: count human-signed lifecycle gates REPORT through CLOSE

synthetic_persona_script_count.formula: count row-level no-personal-data fixtures with expected, actual, result, and failure-branch suite coverage

ordinary_service_continuity_rate.formula: field tasks preserving original order, time, unresolved matters, and staffed path during a confirmed-error hold / all authorized field tasks
ordinary_service_continuity_rate.reason: No authorized field site, legal/professional determination, affected-person co-review, or independent operating baseline is available.

building_height_m.formula: requires approved height and professional constraints
building_height_m.reason: Approved height, aviation, heritage, and engineering controls are unavailable.

silent_coaffected_recovery_rate.formula: non-complainant co-affected people surfaced under an authorized frozen scope / all independently verified non-complainant co-affected people in that scope
silent_coaffected_recovery_rate.reason: No authorized field site, legal/professional determination, affected-person co-review, or independent operating baseline is available.

human_inclusion_review_rate.formula: candidate records receiving a signed include, exclude, or clarification-hold decision / all candidate records surfaced under the authorized scope
human_inclusion_review_rate.reason: No authorized field site, legal/professional determination, affected-person co-review, or independent operating baseline is available.

equal_remedy_completion_time_hours.formula: hours from authorized remedy signature to independently verified remedy receipt, excluding time in documented person-requested pause
equal_remedy_completion_time_hours.reason: No authorized field site, legal/professional determination, affected-person co-review, or independent operating baseline is available.

false_inclusion_rate.formula: people independently found outside the authorized frozen scope after human review / all people included for remedy under that scope
false_inclusion_rate.reason: No authorized field site, legal/professional determination, affected-person co-review, or independent operating baseline is available.

synthetic_test_pass_count.formula: count deterministic synthetic test suites where expected equals actual and every failure branch is declared

synthetic_shared_version_surface_count.formula: count fixtures with frozen_rule_version ERR-V7 surfaced for named human scope review

synthetic_ambiguity_hold_count.formula: count shared-version fixtures held for named human clarification because a required scope field is incomplete

ecosystem_case_count.formula: count documented background case questions in agent.2; not transferred policies or local performance evidence

annual_operation_cycle_count.formula: count distinct proposed operating cycles with an owner, output, conversion path, and stop rule
